name: Meridian
tagline: Treasury for companies that would rather be building.

personality.name: Precise
personality.description: Exact figures and named sources; never rounds away the detail that matters.

personality.name: Unhurried
personality.description: Calm pacing and generous space. Money is serious, not stressful.

personality.name: Editorial
personality.description: Reads like a well-set financial page: serif headlines over quiet supporting text.

personality.name: Trustworthy
personality.description: Says what will happen before it happens and never hides a fee.

voice.summary: Speaks like a good controller: the number first, then the context that explains it. Short sentences, no hype.
do: Runway is 31 months at current burn.
Sent $12,400 to Gusto. It arrives Thursday.
dont: Your transaction processing request has been successfully initiated.

marks.name: Globe
marks.description: A globe crossed by its meridian, the line every position is measured from. The meridian takes the accent where the background allows it.

clearSpace.note: A quarter of the globe's diameter on every side.

minimumSize.note: Below 16 px the meridians close up.

marks.name: Wordmark
marks.description: Meridian set in Instrument Serif and outlined to paths, so it never depends on an installed font.

clearSpace.note: Half the cap height on every side.

minimumSize.note: Below 72 px wide, use the globe alone.

marks.name: Lockup
marks.description: Globe and wordmark on one baseline, as in the product header.

clearSpace.note: Half the lockup's height on every side.

minimumSize.note: Below 96 px wide, use the wordmark or the globe.

do: Lead with the lockup in the product header and on first-touch surfaces.
Use the globe alone for favicons, avatars, and tight spaces.
Keep the meridian in the accent only on light backgrounds.
dont: Stretch, rotate, or outline the marks.
Set the wordmark in Inter Tight or any other face.
Place a mark on photography without a paper or ink backing.
